6 6 6 6 6 6 6 6 5 6 6 6 6 6
6 6 6 6 6 6 6 6 5 6 6 6 6 6'''
grid=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in gridtxt.splitlines()]
from collections import deque
R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); q=deque()
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if (r in [0,R-1] or c in [0,C-1]) and grid[r][c]==6:
   seen.add((r,c));q.append((r,c))
while q:
 r,c=q.popleft()
 for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
  nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
  if 0<=nr<R and 0<=nc<C and grid[nr][nc]==6 and (nr,nc) not in seen:
   seen.add((nr,nc));q.append((nr,nc))
interior=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if grid[r][c]==6 and (r,c) not in seen]
interior, len(interior)
